edges.reason: StandardToken.transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
The overflow guard require(_balances[_to] + _value > _balances[_to]) executes inside transfer.
transfer performs its balance decrement through the safeSub arithmetic operation.
transfer performs its balance increment through the safeAdd arithmetic operation.
transfer delegates subtraction to SafeMath.safeSub.
transfer delegates addition to SafeMath.safeAdd.
StandardToken.transferFrom reads and writes the _balances mapping of _from and _to.
transferFrom reads and decrements _allowed[_from][msg.sender], the spender allowance.
The overflow guard require(_balances[_to] + _value > _balances[_to]) executes inside transferFrom.
transferFrom increments the recipient balance through the safeAdd arithmetic operation.
transferFrom decrements the source balance through the safeSub arithmetic operation.
transferFrom decrements the allowance through the safeSub arithmetic operation.
transferFrom delegates subtraction to SafeMath.safeSub.
transferFrom delegates addition to SafeMath.safeAdd.
StandardToken.balanceOf returns _balances[_owner], a read of the balance mapping.
StandardToken.approve writes _allowed[msg.sender][_spender], changing spend authorization.
StandardToken.allowance reads _allowed[_owner][_spender].
The constructor writes the entire supply into _balances[msg.sender].
The constructor reads totalSupply to mint the initial balance.
msg.sender is the caller whose balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked and debited in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner key used when writing the allowance in approve.
msg.sender receives the whole initial supply in the constructor, an ownership-sensitive flow.
msg.sender indexes _balances in the safeSub call inside transfer.
msg.sender indexes _allowed in the safeSub call inside transferFrom.
Parameter _to indexes _balances[_to] in the overflow guard of transfer.
Parameter _to is used as the key into the _balances mapping in transfer.
Parameter _value participates in the addition of the overflow guard in transfer.
Parameter _value is the subtrahend of safeSub in transfer.
Parameter _value is the addend of safeAdd in transfer.
Parameter _from is the balance key whose value is reduced by safeSub in transferFrom.
Parameter _from is the outer key into _allowed for the allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
Parameter _from indexes the _allowed mapping in transferFrom.
Parameter _to indexes _balances[_to] in the overflow guard of transferFrom.
Parameter _to is the balance key increased by safeAdd in transferFrom.
Parameter _value participates in the addition of the overflow guard in transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the addend of safeAdd in transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the subtrahend of safeSub for the source balance in transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the subtrahend of safeSub for the allowance in transferFrom.
Parameter _owner is the lookup key into _balances in balanceOf.
Parameter _spender is the inner key written into _allowed in approve.
Parameter _value is the allowance amount stored in _allowed by approve.
Parameter _owner is the outer lookup key into _allowed in allowance.
Parameter _spender is the inner lookup key into _allowed in allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only exists to key the _balances mapping inside StandardToken.transfer, so it normalizes into that function.
Parameter _value is only consumed by the arithmetic of StandardToken.transfer, so it normalizes into that function.
Parameter _from is only consumed by the balance and allowance logic of StandardToken.transferFrom, so it normalizes into that function.
Parameter _to is only consumed as the recipient key inside StandardToken.transferFrom, so it normalizes into that function.
Parameter _value drives all arithmetic of StandardToken.transferFrom, so it normalizes into that function.
Parameter _owner is the sole input of StandardToken.balanceOf, so it normalizes into that function.
Parameter _spender is written into _allowed only by StandardToken.approve, so it normalizes into that function.
Parameter _value is the stored allowance of StandardToken.approve, so it normalizes into that function.
Parameter _owner is the outer lookup key of StandardToken.allowance, so it normalizes into that function.
Parameter _spender is the inner lookup key of StandardToken.allowance, so it normalizes into that function.
